comparison.objective: Stack and align two flanges and insert four locating pins; candidate joins a collet and nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part coaxial stacking, bolt-hole registration, and repeated peg insertion versus eccentric groove-to-lip capture and force-controlled snap seating.
comparison.success_condition: Aligned resting flanges with up to four pins at required depths versus one collet retained and withdrawal-resistant.
comparison.reason: Ordinary multi-peg insertion does not test the candidate's changing-axis snap mechanism. Candidate force threshold remains unspecified.
